Name: More Dim Sum
Author: Yuzu17
Description:
[b][color=#ea9999][size=5][font=Courier New]More Dim Sum[/font][/size][/color][/b]
[b][color=#d4d4d8][size=4][font=Courier New]Supports Cornucopia, Wildflour, SVE, RSV.[/font][/size][/color][/b]

[b]
[color=#ea9999][size=5][font=Courier New]New ingredients & items[/font][/size][/color][/b]
[size=4][font=Courier New][b][color=#d4d4d8]1. [/color][color=#ffd966]Secret Woods Shrimp[/color][color=#d4d4d8] : Can only be caught in the lake in the Secret Woods. [/color]
[color=#d4d4d8]2. [/color][color=#ffd966]Secret Shrimp Trap[/color][color=#d4d4d8] : Craft one first. Place it in the lake in the Secret Woods to catch Secret Woods Shrimp. [/color]
[color=#d4d4d8]3. [/color][color=#ffd966]Secret Woods Honeyed Chestnut[/color][color=#d4d4d8] : Forageable in the Secret Woods. [/color]
[color=#d4d4d8]4. [/color][color=#ffd966]Rice Flour[/color][color=#d4d4d8] [/color][color=#d4d4d8]: Mill Rice into Rice Flour. One Rice produces three Rice Flour. [/color][/b][/font][/size]



[font=Courier New][b][color=#00ffff][size=5]Installation instructions[/size][/color][/b]
[b][size=4][color=#d4d4d8]Download and unzip the file.[/color]
[color=#d4d4d8]Place the extracted folder into your Stardew Valley Mods folder. [/color][/size][/b][/font]

Manifest.Name: More Dimsum
Manifest.Description: Unlocks dim sum recipes, restricts shrimp traps to the Secret Woods, and preserves two daily chestnut forage spots.
Manifest.Author: Yuzu17

Manifest.Name: More Dimsum
Manifest.Description: Adds 12 dim sum dishes, rice flour, Secret Woods shrimp, chestnuts, and a craftable shrimp trap. English and Japanese.
Manifest.Author: Yuzu17
